_doc: The Banco of the banker (docs/gdd/04d_otras_clases.md 4.22.5.6; sim/econ/bank.gd) [balance]. applications: at each dawn, per Banco with an owner, chance_per_day (× the bank_applications upgrades; + bank_extra_applications more chances) of a loan application from a townsfolk household: amount in [amount] (× bank_amount upgrades, rounded to round_to), term_days among terms (multiples of installment_days), a risk drawn by its share; it waits expires_days and at most max_open wait at once. risks: what each one accepts as annual interest at most (max_interest, prorated to the term: a year = the days of a year) and its chance of not paying each installment (default, × bank_default upgrades). A granted loan is paid in equal installments every installment_days; a household pays from outside (P4). An unpaid installment: the loan is in default; each later dawn, late_payment.chance_per_day that the household pays all it owes plus late_payment.surcharge, unless the banker claims the collateral (claim_collateral, from claim_after_days in default): the town gives back recovery.notarized (a notarial loan: a «contract» in the Banco's storage was used when granting) or recovery.plain of what is owed (+ bank_recovery upgrades), and the rest is lost. Families (human or AI) ask a Banco with request_loan (lender = the Banco): their application waits there; an AI owner decides at dawn (accepts if the borrower's wealth covers ai_accepts_cover × the amount, at ai_interest of the risk's maximum); a family's loan follows the debt rules of 4.16 and what it pays goes to the banker. Category of the banker's ledger: bank_lent (what is lent and comes back), interest (what it earns), bank_losses (what is lost).
